card.summary: Lets an agent send a message once a person has approved it.
card.example: The agent drafts an email to a vendor. A person reads it, then chooses Send.
cost: Billed for each message sent, or for each step when the message goes through a workflow.
needs: A sender address your organization owns.
A named person who approves every message.
card.safety: The agent only drafts. A person must approve every send, and nothing goes out on its own.
card.service: Azure Communication Services email, or Logic Apps
card.billing: Per message, or per action for Logic Apps.
